text: Home is a dashboard that shows items needing attention, still-running work, a daily brief, and suggestions

text: Onboarding suggests concrete starter Tasks based on what the user says about their work

text: Tabs shrink to fit, overflow into a dropdown, can be pinned, and close with a middle click

quote: Connect a local Agent through one wizard. Setting up an Agent on your own machine now runs through a single guided flow instead of a different path per connector.

quote: Install local tools on the desktop app. Desktop can now install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine or your local network.

text: Agent profiles have a source mode for editing their raw Markdown directly
quote: Write your Agent profile in Markdown. Agent profiles have a source mode for editing the raw Markdown directly.

text: The desktop app includes a terminal with session tabs, right-click close actions, and fast rendering
quote: The desktop terminal now has clearer tabs, right-click actions to close one or all other sessions, smoother open and close transitions, and faster rendering for active terminals.
